description: 2 to 5 options seen together, one always selected (DESIGN.md, SegmentedControl): one tab stop with roving focus; arrows both move and select, as native radios do on the web. A TsuyaColors.fill track with a hairline, TsuyaSpace.s4 inside; the selected segment is TsuyaColors.fillSelected with TsuyaShadows.sm. expand shares the width between segments; otherwise each hugs its own content, until they no longer fit: they then share the width in proportion to their content and labels wrap onto more lines.

constructors.description: A control over segments, selected chosen, named label for screen readers.

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called with a segment's value when it is chosen.

params.name: expand
params.description: Shares the width equally between segments, instead of each hugging its own content.
